payload.title: The real-repo-baseline fixture case repeats the adapter's scan roots by hand and no gate ties its input.roots to the manifest's default_input.roots (doc-staleness now carries a 13-root copy), so the baseline can validate a surface production does not scan
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/fixtures/doc-staleness-adapter/cases/real-repo-baseline.json:4-20 (the case input lists the 13 roots itself)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.test.ts:218-223 (the new pin ties the manifest's three lists to the test constants, not to the fixture case)
tests/invariants/adapter-scan-surface-authority.spec.ts:4-16 (the header names this hazard: fixtures validating a file set production never scans, every test green)
tests/invariants/adapter-scan-surface-authority.spec.ts:74-89 (the invariant checks roots against declared_scope only; it never reads a fixture case input)
payload.rule_violated: tests/invariants/adapter-scan-surface-authority.spec.ts (PROGRAM H / H-1): an adapter's scan surface is declared once; the manifest default_input.roots is the authority.
payload.notes: A later edit that adds or removes a doc-staleness root updates the manifest and the test constants (the test fails until both agree) but not the baseline case, and the case keeps measuring the old 13-root surface against its max_findings 400 ceiling while production scans another surface, with no test red. Checked across all 19 real-repo-baseline cases at this revision: every case roots list equals its manifest roots today, so the pin would be green now and nothing enforces it. Close condition: Add an invariant to adapter-scan-surface-authority.spec.ts asserting that, for every adapter with a real-repo-baseline case, the case input.roots equals the manifest default_input.roots (or the case omits roots and inherits them); it is checkable by editing a manifest root and seeing the invariant fail. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
